metadata.title: hyperCAD-S Datum / Reference Geometry Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Exhaustive parameter catalog for hyperCAD-S Datum / Reference Geometry workspace. Datums are the scaffolding behind every other module — sketches snap to reference planes / axes / points, surface ops use coordinate systems for orientation, hyperMILL reads datum frames as WCS origins. Catalog covers: 1 reference-plane op (10 creation modes), 1 reference-axis op (8 creation modes), 1 reference-point op (12 creation modes), 1 coordinate-system op (6 alignment strategies), and 2 reference-curve ops (Spline-3D / Polyline-3D).
metadata.source: OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S Reference Geometry Manual, hyperMILL WCS / Datum Frame Reference

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across hyperCAD-S datum operations

REFERENCE_PLANE.description: Reference plane created by one of 10 standard methods. Reference planes are first-class sketch targets and act as section / cut planes throughout solid + surface modules.

REFERENCE_AXIS.description: Reference axis created by one of 8 standard methods. Axes act as rotation centers for revolve / circular-pattern, alignment lines for coordinate-system construction, and hyperMILL spindle-axis references.

parameters.name: Reference Points
parameters.description: Two points (two_points / from_three_points_normal — 3 points define plane whose normal is the axis)

parameters.name: Reference Face
parameters.description: Face for normal / cylindrical / conical modes

parameters.name: Origin Override
parameters.description: Optional anchor (defaults to first reference point)

REFERENCE_POINT.description: Reference point created by one of 12 standard methods. Points act as snap targets for sketches, anchor positions for joints / mates, and pick-points for hyperMILL probing routines.

parameters.name: Reference Edge
parameters.description: Edge / curve (midpoint / endpoint / by_curve_parameter / center modes)

COORDINATE_SYSTEM.description: Coordinate system (3-axis frame) created by one of 6 alignment strategies. Coordinate systems double as hyperMILL WCS frames — selecting a coordinate system as WCS origin emits the corresponding G54..G59 / G54.1 P# offset in NC output.

parameters.name: X Axis Reference
parameters.description: Edge / line / axis defining X direction (origin_x_y / origin_two_axes modes)

parameters.name: Y Axis Reference
parameters.description: Edge / line / axis defining Y direction (origin_two_axes mode)

parameters.name: Reference Face
parameters.description: Face whose normal becomes Z and whose u-direction becomes X (from_face mode)

parameters.name: Source Coordinate System
parameters.description: Existing coord system to derive from (from_existing_coordsys mode)

parameters.name: Translate
parameters.description: Offset from reference origin (defaults to zero)

parameters.name: Rotate Z
parameters.description: Rotation about Z after axis derivation

parameters.name: WCS Tag
parameters.description: Optional hyperMILL WCS designator (e.g. 'G54', 'G54.1 P3') emitted in NC output

REFERENCE_SPLINE_3D.description: 3D reference spline through control / interpolation points. Used as guide rail for sweeps, cam-path defining curve, and hyperMILL 5-axis tool-axis driver curve.

parameters.name: Closed
parameters.description: Close spline back to first point

REFERENCE_POLYLINE_3D.description: 3D reference polyline (linear segments through points). Distinct from spline — polyline preserves sharp vertices, useful for facet-driven hyperMILL roughing strategies.

parameters.name: Auto Smooth Sharp Corners
parameters.description: Insert small fillet at each vertex (converts polyline to spline-of-arcs internally)

platform_notes.hypermill_wcs: COORDINATE_SYSTEM with a populated WCS Tag is read by hyperMILL post-processing — the tag drops directly into the NC output as the active WCS offset. This is the bridge between CAD reference frames and CNC controller offset registers.
platform_notes.ten_methods_per_op: Each ref-plane / axis / point op consolidates many creation strategies into a single parametric op via a 'Mode' dropdown. Per-mode parameters are gated by mode selection.
platform_notes.sketch_targeting: Sketches in sketch_operations module accept any reference plane / face / axis as their Sketch Plane parameter.
